original_card.question: Does a new paid-profile or mixture-ceiling claim have independent source-bound coverage of its actual changed ledger?
methods: Independently reconstruct one changed paid ledger or pooled dual with exact source and model binding.
Check a genuinely uncovered moment implication with a different enclosure method and semantic controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

first_step.inspect: Choose one uncovered implication in #4088 literal mixed fill, #4091 pooled dual/model binding or #4067 changed frame/host bill. #4091 pins an earlier #4088 head: validate word, capacity and stock equivalence before applying that ceiling to the later fill.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; no scientific replay, theorem acceptance or supplier admission. Budget any heavy replay separately.

original_card.first_experiment: Independently reconstruct one changed ledger or pooled certificate with a positive case and a semantic failure control. Compare exact sources and name what existing checks miss. Keep this separate from supplier-boundary-audit (ordinary/outer dispatch) and uniform-transfer-audit (all-size proof). Stop after the chosen implication; more digits of an unchanged root are not additional mechanism coverage.

actual_scope: Does a new paid-profile or mixture-ceiling claim have independent source-bound coverage of its actual changed ledger?
bottleneck_link: Strengthens a negative result on the native supplier: no optimistic paid-moment headroom from up to six unit shears in #4546's twelve windows, so a profile change must come from a different model.
stop_rule: Stop at length 6 on all 128 eligible windows.
evidence: Own window extraction from main's #4470 constructor matches #4546 on its twelve windows (length<=4 census and ceilings reproduced exactly); lengths 5 and 6 leave those twelve unchanged at 0; all 128 eligible windows (123 B, 5 cleanup_tail) have ceiling exactly 0 at lengths <=4 and <=6. #4543's receiver-sharing word on all 128 windows: incumbent admitted in 96, infeasible in 32 (S_b not inside E_a), never improves. Nonunit coefficients on all 128 windows: {±1,±2} to length 6 and {±1,±2,±3} to length 5, every ceiling 0. 88 nonadjacent pairs: 87 zero by relaxation; one (11334/11344) has a loose relaxed bound 0.0026 but exact nested-subspace search gives no gain for all 186 positive words. Single-contact retiming: all 16,089 two-operand contacts in all phases already cost-minimising (exact). Two-contact joint retiming: 26,092 consecutive pairs, 26,042 zero by relaxation, 50 zero by exact geometry. Agreement with #4581, #4582 and #4587: identical all-length/length-6 profile sets in all 128 windows; majorization and telescoping rechecked. Exact geometry: #4543's receiver-sharing word realises the incumbent exactly in all 96 feasible windows.
